ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: From the food web diagram, which species gets directly affected if all rabbits die?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram, which contains organisms such as mountain lion, snake, hawk, owl, frog, cricket, mouse, rabbit, deer, trees, shrubs, grasses, etc. rabbit is located in the lower-middle part of the picture, and there is a food relationship arrow in the picture from rabbit pointing to the mountain lion at the upper left. Reasoning: The question asks if all the rabbits died, which species would be directly affected. Directly affected refers to the consumers that directly feed on rabbits and have a direct food arrow connection with rabbits. In the picture, rabbit is directly connected to mountain lion, so the one directly affected is lion.
